name: Bell
description: Rings clear and carries a long way. Good for dinner, visitors, and waking the apprentice.
logic: Iron rings true, a clear tone for warning.

name: Parchment
description: Smooth, pale, and patient. Waits years for you to write something worth keeping.
logic: Earth provides the structure, mud the binding. Like clay fired in a kiln.

name: Lead based ink
description: A dark ink with a serious shine. Stays where you put it, including on your sleeve.
logic: Shadow hides what is written. Lead obscures the light.

name: Ruby dust
description: Red, glittering, and warm between the fingers. A pinch goes a long way, which is just as well.
logic: Fire consumes and transforms, while life provides the raw material for that change.

name: Mica
description: Thin stone flakes that catch the light and split like pastry.
logic: Shadow clings to earth, obscuring its light and revealing a fractured, shimmering surface.

name: White cloth
description: Clean, soft, and freshly aired. Smells of sunshine and the washing line.
logic: Life clings to wood, and withering brings forth pale fibers.

name: Agate
description: A stone with stripes, as if it could not decide. Cool in the hand and pleasant to fidget with.
logic: Sand, compressed and heated, forms the layered structure of agate.

name: Silk square
description: A small square of something very smooth. It whispers when folded.
logic: Steam’s heat softens and binds tree fibers, drawing them into a flexible weave.

name: Copper coin
description: Small, brown, and warm from someone's pocket. Buys a bun, or most of one.
logic: Sand is ground stone. Copper is a metal. Combining them creates a solid, workable form.

name: Incense
description: A little stick that turns into a nice smell. The room feels tidier at once.
logic: Smoke obscures, shadow conceals; together, they veil the senses.

name: Burning incense
description: Incense, already doing its job. A thin ribbon of smoke and the smell of someone concentrating.
logic: Smoke carries scent, and air carries it further. A burning scent clings to the memory.

name: Licorice root
description: A sweet, woody root for chewing. Makes you want to walk somewhere quickly.
logic: Roots draw sustenance from the earth, and the mind seeks knowledge and direction. Combining them creates a substance of…

name: Molasses
description: Dark, sweet, and in no hurry at all. Gets on everything eventually.
logic: Rotted leaves provide the dark, sweet base, and tree adds the richness and viscosity.

name: Diamond
description: Very hard, very bright, and aware of both. Catches the light and keeps showing it to you.
logic: Smoke is the essence of burning, and diamond is born of intense pressure and heat.

name: Holy symbol
description: A small token, worn smooth by a thumb. Whatever it stands for, somebody means it.
logic: Smoke rises, a visible prayer to the unseen. Light guides it upward.

name: Acid
description: Sour water with ambitions. Cleans a kettle in no time and should not meet the good spoons.
logic: Brimstone taken up in water

name: Lightning
description: What a storm keeps in its pocket. Smells faintly of toast and thunder.
logic: A storm cloud breaking

name: Force
description: A firm, invisible shove. Like steam in a kettle that has made up its mind.
logic: Steam shut inside iron, pushing to get out

name: Venom
description: Collected politely from creatures who would rather keep it. Tingles, and should not go in the tea.
logic: What a beast kills with

name: Poison
description: Venom, watered down until it pours. Mostly it makes you regret lunch.
logic: Venom let down until it can be poured

name: Spark
description: A bright little snap off the flint. Gone before you can thank it.
logic: Iron struck on stone

name: Lantern
description: A flame that agreed to stay behind glass. Shows the path and attracts moths with opinions.
logic: A flame kept behind glass

name: Candle
description: Wax, a wick, and a small steady flame. Makes any room look like someone is expected.
logic: Tallow and a wick

name: Staff
description: A good branch with an iron cap. Excellent for walking, pointing, and leaning on thoughtfully.
logic: A branch shod in iron
